name: meeting-notes-transcripts
description: Turn provided meeting transcripts into concise summaries, decisions, action items, and open questions with source references. Works in ChatGPT and Codex, including ChatGPT on iPhone where plugins are available. Paste a transcript or attach a readable transcript file. Unknown owners and deadlines stay unknown. Save to your Meetings page in Spaces when requested and when the host provides Pages capabilities; otherwise receive editable notes in chat. This skills-only edition does not record audio or detect online meetings. The separate open source Mac companion provides those functions.
